fields.description: Which check this row runs. Add a row for every check you want, in the order you want them to run — drag the rows to reorder.
fields.label: Guardrail

fields.description: What happens when this check finds a problem. Off — do not run the check. Log Only — note it and continue. Retry Once — try the request once more, then stop (only the Reply Check retries; the others treat this as Block). Block — stop the request. For a Hide check (Personal or Health Information), this does not control masking — masking runs whenever this is not Off. It only sets what happens when something cannot be masked, for example an image.
fields.label: Action
